strategy: Use the highest available Claude tier by agent role. This mapping is based on the local Kiro CLI model list provided by the user.

rolePolicy.opus: Highest-reasoning agents: orchestration, deep work, planning, and strategic technical advice.
rolePolicy.sonnet: Strong balanced agents: plan execution, plan critique, pre-planning consultation, and visual/media interpretation.
rolePolicy.haiku: Fast economical agents: local exploration, external documentation lookup, and small bounded execution.

fallback: If a mapped model is unavailable in another Kiro account, set that agent to `auto` or the nearest available tier from the same family.
